Beta Launch & Waitlist Campaign Generator v1.0.0

- Initial release with 4 distinct prompts covering waitlist landing pages, sequenced pre-launch email campaigns, Product Hunt launch kits, and early-access nurture/upgrade sequences.
- Designed for SaaS, apps, hardware, courses, and community launches.
- Offers a free tier: comprehensive waitlist landing page copy generator.
- Paid tier unlocks additional campaign assets and templates for seamless product launches.
- Includes detailed input requirements and example outputs for clarity.
